purpose: Centralized external dependency manifest for build/test scripts. Official Unikraft core and libraries come from KraftKit package sources; repo-local Git checkouts below cover non-Kraft upstreams such as llama.cpp and Vulkan headers. Override any path via the matching environment variable.

LLAMA_ROOT.description: Pinned upstream llama.cpp checkout. Sources are compiled in-tree; the Vulkan preparation target generates SPIR-V shader sources.

VENUS_PROTOCOL_ROOT.description: Pinned venus-protocol checkout providing protocol headers for libukvulkan_venus and host tests.

VULKAN_HEADERS_INCLUDE.description: Pinned Vulkan-Hpp/Vulkan-Headers include dir used by ggml-vulkan and the Unikraft Vulkan shim.

SPIRV_HEADERS_INCLUDE.description: Pinned SPIR-V headers used by ggml-vulkan upstream compile.

VK_INC.description: Vulkan + Venus headers used by host-side vulkan_compute_test (tests/Makefile).

VK_LIB.description: Host Vulkan loader linked into vulkan_compute_test. Path is system-default on Debian/Ubuntu; override on other hosts.

HOST_CXX_INCLUDE.description: Optional: host C++ standard-library include dir injected into the cmake toolchain. Leave unset to use the compiler's default search path.

HOST_GCC_LIB.description: Optional: host GCC runtime library dir injected into the cmake toolchain.
